title: xAI's neocloud pivot eats up 82.7% of SpaceX capex
excerpt: Elon Musk’s xAI has been lagging in its fight with fellow large language model providers OpenAI and Anthropic for consumer and enterprise market share, with...
content_html:
Elon Musk's xAI has been lagging in its fight with fellow large language model providers OpenAI and Anthropic for consumer and enterprise market share, with its Grok chatbot up against ChatGPT and Claude.

SpaceX's Q2 earnings reveal it may be giving up that fight altogether as adoption of Grok stalls.

The earnings, which continue to provide the most detailed picture to date of the financial inner workings of an LLM provider, show the company's pivoting to become an AI neocloud company by renting out access to AI infrastructure. But with expenses in the vertical exploding 105% from Q1 to Q2, it's an expensive proposition.

"Frankly, the only way for them to make money right now is in data centers, and they've been building it very fast," said Nicolas Owens, an equity analyst covering SpaceX for Morningstar, referring to the company's build-out of its Colossus II data center in Tennessee and Mississippi and expansion of its Colossus I center in Memphis.

Sign up for The Daily Pitch newsletter Subscribe

"Right now, it's a gold rush for compute capacity, and they've said as long as there's demand, they're going to keep building."

But that building is coming at a huge cost to SpaceX: It spent more on AI in Q2 than it did in all of 2025.

From Q1 to Q2, its AI capital expenditures more than doubled from $7.7 billion to $15.8 billion. For additional context, its total xAI capex spend last year was $12.7 billion. Looking at the entirety of SpaceX's 2026 capex, xAI spend accounted for 82.7%, or $23.5 billion, of the company's $28.4 billion.

"It's still really early days for this AI business," Owens said. "I think it's going to be a decade before they turn a profit on this because they're building as fast as they can and spending hand over fist for data centers."

There are some signs the pivot is paying off.

On an adjusted EBITDA basis, xAI swung heavily from Q1 to Q2, moving from a loss of $609 million to a gain of $1.1 billion. Nearly all of that growth came from renting out access to GPUs, as its S-1 filings disclosed. Clients included the likes of Anthropic, which had signed a deal to become a major compute customer and agreed to pay $1.25 billion per month to rent GPU servers at Colossus I. The S-1 also revealed that Google signed a contract to rent access for $920 million a month.

"On the AI compute side, we're able to deploy capital in such a way that we're getting less than a one-year payback," said SpaceX's CFO Bret Johnsen in the Tuesday earnings call.

SpaceX investors endorse the pivot amid fears that, despite its acquisition of the agentic coding startup Cursor, xAI's Grok isn't able to compete with Anthropic and OpenAI's LLM offerings.

content_html_zh:
埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 xAI 在与其他大型语言模型提供商 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 争夺消费者和企业市场份额方面一直处于落后地位，其 Grok 聊天机器人与 ChatGPT 和 Claude 对抗。

SpaceX 第二季度财报显示，由于 Grok 的采用陷入停滞，该公司可能会完全放弃这场斗争。

财报继续提供了法学硕士提供商迄今为止最详细的财务内部运作情况，显示该公司正在通过出租人工智能基础设施的访问权，转向成为一家人工智能新云公司。 但由于垂直行业的支出从第一季度到第二季度激增 105%，这是一个昂贵的提议。

晨星公司研究 SpaceX 的股票分析师尼古拉斯·欧文斯 (Nicolas Owens) 表示：“坦率地说，他们目前赚钱的唯一途径就是数据中心，而且他们的建设速度非常快。”他指的是该公司在田纳西州和密西西比州扩建 Colossus II 数据中心以及在孟菲斯扩建 Colossus I 数据中心。

订阅 The Daily Pitch 时事通讯

“目前，这是计算能力的淘金热，他们表示，只要有需求，他们就会继续建设。”

但这座建筑让 SpaceX 付出了巨大的代价：第二季度在人工智能上的支出比 2025 年全年还要多。

从第一季度到第二季度，其人工智能资本支出增长了一倍多，从 77 亿美元增至 158 亿美元。 另外，去年 xAI 资本支出总额为 127 亿美元。 从 SpaceX 2026 年资本支出总额来看，xAI 支出占该公司 284 亿美元资本支出的 82.7%，即 235 亿美元。

“对于人工智能业务来说，现在还处于早期阶段，”欧文斯说。 “我认为他们需要十年时间才能盈利，因为他们正在尽可能快地建设数据中心，并为数据中心投入巨资。”

有一些迹象表明，这一转向正在取得成效。

在调整后的 EBITDA 基础上，xAI 从第一季度到第二季度大幅波动，从亏损 6.09 亿美元变为盈利 11 亿美元。 正如其 S-1 文件披露的那样，几乎所有增长都来自 GPU 的出租。 客户包括 Anthropic 等公司，该公司已签署协议成为主要计算客户，并同意每月支付 12.5 亿美元在 Colossus I 租用 GPU 服务器。 S-1 还透露，谷歌签署了一份每月 9.2 亿美元的租用合同。

SpaceX 首席财务官布雷特·约翰森 (Bret Johnsen) 在周二的财报电话会议上表示：“在人工智能计算方面，我们能够以不到一年的时间就可以收回投资。”

SpaceX 的投资者支持这一转变，因为他们担心，尽管 xAI 收购了代理编码初创公司 Cursor，但 xAI 的 Grok 无法与 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的法学硕士产品竞争。
